text:
sam: Heads-up — after the policy header switch in canary (policy_v3) we saw a spike in telemetry errors and a couple 400s from internal proxies. Rolling log excerpt:

sam: ```
WARN route-dispatcher: missing header X-RW-POLICY for req id=abcd1234
ERROR http: 400 "unknown-routing-policy" host=svc-infer
``` 

sam: The SDKs are now sending `X-RW-POLICY: v3` but the internal sensor still expects `x-redwood-route`.

maria: Oof. Did the canary flip include the sensor config change? I thought that was gated.

anika: It was supposed to be gated. I see the sensor PR merged yesterday — misaligned env parsing for case sensitivity.

liam: How many apps hit this? Paging the console metrics — policy_mismatch count jumped ~2.2k in last 10m.

sam: Mostly hosted-api and a few Dedicated customers on older SDKs. My quick fix: add a tolerant header lookup in sensor to accept both keys and lowercase variants.

maria: That fixes prod quick. But longer term we need a coordinated SDK+sensor contract. Options:
- SDK shim to send both headers for 2 weeks
- Sensor tolerant parsing (non-breaking)
- Console indicator that flags clients sending legacy header

liam: I'd vote for SDK shim + console flag. Developers get immediate compatibility and console can show who to nudge.

anika: SDK shim is safest but we need to avoid double-billing routing telemetry. The shim should send the canonical header plus an internal ephemeral header `X-RW-LEGACY` for transition only.

sam: Proposed shim payload: ```http
X-RW-POLICY: v3
X-RW-LEGACY: x-redwood-route
``` This way sensor can attribute but only honor canonical header for routing.

maria: Agree. Also console should add a per-customer column "policy_version_seen" and a small alert when legacy header present >1% traffic.

liam: Rollout plan:
1) Hotfix sensor to accept both headers for 48h (ops)
2) Cut SDK patch in py/ts/go to send both headers behind a feature flag (devex)
3) Console telemetry tile + alert (product)
4) After 2 weeks, remove LEGACY header and set sensor to only accept canonical. Announce in #customer-notify

deploy-bot: deploys/service/sensor v1.12.3 started

ops-bot: hotfix applied to canary — sensor will accept both headers for next 48h

anika: I'll own sensor PR to keep parsing case-insensitive and add a small metric `policy_header_variants`

liam: I'll draft the customer message and the console tile mockups.

maria: Can we also add tests in the SDK CI to assert headers are set? Prevent accidental regressions.

sam: Yes. Adding test tasks to the SDK issues. Thanks everyone — let's sync 30m after the hotfix to confirm telemetry stabilizes. :thumbsup:
